description: This file provides utility functions for visualizing object detection results, such as drawing bounding boxes, captions, and annotations on images, specifically tailored for use with RetinaNet detections in the ImageAI package.

methods.name: draw_box(image, box, color, thickness=2)
methods.description: Draws a rectangle on an image with specified coordinates and color.

methods.name: draw_caption(image, box, caption)
methods.description: Draws a textual caption above a bounding box in an image.

methods.name: draw_boxes(image, boxes, color, thickness=2)
methods.description: Iterates over multiple boxes and draws each on the image using draw_box.

methods.name: draw_detections(image, boxes, scores, labels, color=None, label_to_name=None, score_threshold=0.5)
methods.description: Draws detection boxes and labels with scores onto an image, filtering by score threshold.

methods.name: draw_annotations(image, annotations, color=(0, 255, 0), label_to_name=None)
methods.description: Draws annotation boxes and labels (from a structured annotations dictionary or array) onto an image.

ctags.name: draw_detections
ctags.pattern: /^def draw_detections(image, boxes, scores, labels, color=None, label_to_name=None, score_threshol/
ctags.signature: (image, boxes, scores, labels, color=None, label_to_name=None, score_threshold=0.5)
